article_summaries.title: Summer Camp - Treasure Hunting Week
article_summaries.summary: A Free Realms official news post from the 2010 Summer Camp series, themed Treasure Hunting Week. It lists the ways players could find treasure (mining, Robgoblin Junk Piles, hidden exploration tokens, pet digging) and the expected schedule of in-game and TCG community events, plus how to use the Game Guide calendar to teleport to events. The post gives expected schedules, not confirmed ones.

article_summaries.title: Summer Camp - Pet Week
article_summaries.summary: A freerealms.com news post announcing Pet Week, the final theme of the 2010 Summer Camp community event season. It describes a pet parade from Crossroads to Sanctuary and the expected schedule of in-game and TCG events, and explains how to find events through the Game Guide calendar. The post gives a relative posting time ('2 days, 21 hours ago') and no absolute date.
